title: Product Catalog API
description: The product catalog API allows the merchants to create a catalog and organize the products with detailed specifications under their store.

apis.heading: Create Product Catalog
apis.description: This API lets you to create a product catalog for your store to make an effortless product organization in the catalog.

reqParams.name: storeId
reqParams.description: Unique identifier of the store where the catalog will be created.

reqParams.name: startDate
reqParams.description: Date the catalog becomes active, in ISO 8601 format. When omitted, the catalog has no start date.

reqParams.name: endDate
reqParams.description: Date the catalog expires, in ISO 8601 format. When omitted, the catalog has no end date.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: Response data

resParams.name: catalogId
resParams.description: Unique ID of the newly created catalog.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Fetch Product Catalogs
apis.description: Retrieves all product catalogs under the store.

resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: Response data

resParams.name: catalogIds

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.
